**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback-level cure).**

- **What fails:** Section 16.1 warrants only that M&I's systems are "capable of performing the Services" (16.1.A) and that reports are in "substantial conformity with the customer bulletins and the User Manuals" (16.1.B). A report-to-manual warranty is not a software-to-documentation conformance warranty, and no repair/replace/refund remedy exists (Article 12 gives only cure/terminate; the Section 10.4 refund relates to Developed Software resale). Section 16.1.F disclaims everything else.
- **What is already met:** Section 9.1's term-long Services performance obligation covers the fallback 30-day Services warranty duration (the preferred "professional and workmanlike" standard is noted, not pressed).
- **Cure:** one inserted subsection G — 90-day software conformance to documentation plus repair, replacement or refund — which is automatically carved out of the 16.1.F disclaimer's "EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1" opener, so no collateral edit to the disclaimer is needed.
